digest.component_or_area: review-bot Bedrock IAM grant (Terraform instance-role policy)
propositions: The review-bot container needs Bedrock credentials, but the rebar-gerrit-instance-role grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt with no Bedrock permission.
The grant must add a scoped inline Bedrock policy in a new iam_s7.tf without modifying iam.tf, honoring the single-owner contract for the instance role.

The correct authorized action is bedrock:InvokeModel + bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not bedrock:Converse/ConverseStream), because the Converse API authorizes against InvokeModel as proven by a real from-instance call.

A policy simulator only reports what the named action permits, not which action the service checks, so validation requires a real from-instance call plus a non-Claude negative control, never a wildcard-holding identity.
IMDS reachability from the container must be probed empirically; if unreachable, set http_put_response_hop_limit=2 keeping http_tokens=required and record the exception in ADR 0046.
The policy must be scoped to Claude foundation models and inference profiles with wildcard region and profile prefix so cross-region and global.* profiles are not silently denied.
